# Vendored sources, pinned by content.
#
# The drop's Render build installs from these files by name, so the filename
# already carries the upstream commit. A name is not a check: swap the bytes
# and nothing notices. organum lost a day to the near-miss version of this
# (their 0.4.11 arc — git's newline normalization silently changed a vendored
# file's SHA, so the pin held in the working tree and broke only in a clean
# checkout). We pin by content so the same class of drift fails loudly here.
#
# Each tarball is byte-reproducible from its upstream commit:
#   git -C <organum-repo> archive -o vendor/<file> <commit>
# Verified deterministic across repeated generation. tests/test_vendor_pin.py
# crosses this file against the bytes on disk.
#
# file  sha256  upstream-commit  version

organum-6c42cb8.tar.gz  e52787424f554f0f84216f92ea2f46f3cce4a7052afe05891652ffeef8f9b900  6c42cb8  0.4.16
